scope: Instrumentation and focused tests only; no native browser, build, release, version bump, runtime ownership experiment, or acceptance change.

change.independent_observer: Public Playwright browser CDP session on the already owned browser records Browser.getVersion, sanitized initial and live Target events, and independent old/replacement getTargetInfo probes after strict retirement timeout.
change.version_observer: Public CDP session for the owned fixture page records extension-scoped ServiceWorker versions and registrations; old versionId correlation requires a targetId match before click, otherwise remains unmeasured.
change.capture: Existing target snapshots/events now preserve boolean attached. Lifetime evidence is bounded and sanitized through the existing success/failure capture path.
change.cleanup: Only listeners and diagnostic sessions created by this unit are removed; ServiceWorker is disabled on its diagnostic page session when live.

negative_checks: Simulated missing old Target.targetDestroyed keeps the original strict retirement failure despite old snapshot absence and replacement presence; independent destruction, stopped correlated version and target-absent probe survive failure capture.
Present, target-absent, and disconnected host probes yield different fixed classifications; unknown old version remains unmeasured.
Existing context and management failure cases still fail; diagnostic listeners and sessions are removed after probe failure.
verification.format: Biome format and git diff --check passed on owned files.

limits: No native Chromium lifecycle observed by this unit; the owner will run one guarded native measurement after independent review.
A fixture page storage partition may not expose extension ServiceWorker versions; this is reported as unavailable/unmeasured and never inferred from URL alone.
No causal repair or relaxation of the retirement predicate is justified.
